Name CAPE (CubeSat Atmospheric Probe for Education)
Type CubeSat
Units or mass 3U
Status cancelled
Organisation University of Stuttgart
Institution University
Entity Academic / Education
Country Germany
Oneliner

Has a separable capsule called micro-return capsule 2 (MIRKA2).
Description

Service & Deorbit Module (SDM) and a separable capsule called micro-return capsule 2 (MIRKA2). Develop a relatively cheap platform for examining heat shields for re-entry vehicles and small payloads. Pulsed plasma thruster (PPT).
Notes

Same name and concept as NASA CAPE MIRCA mission, coincidence?
